description: ForgePass indexer polling strategy — v1 signal sources only. Three confirmed v1 sources: GitHub (Stellar ecosystem repos), Stellar Horizon (transactions, trades, operations), and Aquarius LP (via Horizon operations pass). GrantFox, Trustless Work, and SCF are reserved as future sources pending partnership confirmation in #009.

github.rationale: Polling-primary chosen over webhooks for uniform coverage of all registered Stellar repos, including those outside the forgepass-xyz GitHub organisation where org-level webhooks would not apply. GitHub App installation token provides 15,000 req/hr — sufficient for up to 500 registered repos at 15-minute intervals. Per-repo query strategy fetches all merged PRs since last cursor and matches contributors by GitHub username, avoiding the per-contributor per-repo combinatorial explosion. Webhooks were evaluated and ruled out: org-level webhooks cover only forgepass-xyz-internal repos, requiring polling for external Stellar repos regardless, making a dual architecture unjustified.

HORIZON_TRANSACTIONS.rationale: Batch polling chosen over SSE streaming. Public Horizon endpoint rate-limits at 3,600 req/hr per IP; SSE heartbeats count as requests (~720/hr per open stream), making streaming infeasible at scale on the public endpoint. Third-party providers remove the rate limit but add infrastructure cost and vendor dependency for a latency benefit that is invisible to downstream consumers of a reputation system with a 60-second recalculation SLA. 5-minute polling interval is well within acceptable lag. paging_token cursor is monotonically increasing, durable across process restarts, and gap-free.

HORIZON_TRADES.rationale: Separate pass from HORIZON_TRANSACTIONS for independent cursor management and failure isolation per the indexer_runs design decision. A failure in trade indexing must not stall transaction indexing for the same contributor. Identical polling mechanism and interval to HORIZON_TRANSACTIONS for scheduler simplicity.

HORIZON_OPERATIONS.aquarius_note: Aquarius LP positions are sourced from this pass rather than from the Aquarius API directly. The Aquarius API does not document a per-account LP position endpoint, has no published rate limits, exposes no streaming interface, and rotates contract addresses on testnet. LP share trustlines and deposit/withdrawal operations are fully visible in the Horizon operations stream, removing the need for a separate Aquarius API dependency. Current LP share balances are additionally readable from account trustlines via GET /accounts/{id} as a supplementary call within this pass.
HORIZON_OPERATIONS.rationale: Soroban contract deployments (invoke_host_function) and Aquarius LP events (liquidity_pool_deposit, liquidity_pool_withdraw) both surface in the account operations stream, making a single pass sufficient for both signal types at no extra request cost. Uniform 5-minute interval with other Horizon passes maintains a single scheduler cadence and avoids special-casing.

horizon.provider_note: Public SDF Horizon endpoint (https://horizon.stellar.org) used for v1. Horizon historical data truncated to 1 year as of August 2024 on the public endpoint — contributors with activity older than 1 year will require a third-party provider (QuickNode, Blockdaemon) or self-hosted Horizon for full history ingestion on first onboarding. Third-party provider to be re-evaluated if contributor scale exceeds public rate limit headroom or sub-5-minute latency becomes a product requirement.

indexer_runs_schema.description: Required columns for the indexer_runs table in #013. One row per contributor per pass type.

columns.last_successful_cursor: TEXT — ISO 8601 timestamp for GITHUB_PRS; paging_token string for Horizon passes
columns.last_run_at: TIMESTAMP — when this pass last executed
columns.consecutive_failure_count: INTEGER — resets to 0 on any SUCCESS; alert threshold is 3
columns.failure_reason: TEXT — last error message or null on success

GRANTFOX_BOUNTY.note: Strategy block to be populated when GrantFox partnership is confirmed. Ingestion method (webhook vs polling) to be determined based on GrantFox API availability. A GRANTFOX_BOUNTY pass_type will be added to the indexer_runs ENUM at that time.

TRUSTLESS_WORK.note: Strategy block to be populated when Trustless Work partnership is confirmed. Milestone completion events expected via webhook with HMAC signature verification. A TRUSTLESS_WORK pass_type will be added to the indexer_runs ENUM at that time.

SCF_GRANT.gated_on: #009 (FR-09-B — SCF partnership confirmation and ingestion method agreement)
SCF_GRANT.note: Strategy block to be populated when SCF partnership and ingestion method are confirmed. SCF does not currently expose a public API. A SCF_GRANT pass_type will be added to the indexer_runs ENUM at that time.

changelog.summary: Initial strategy. Three v1 sources defined. GitHub: REST polling, GitHub App installation token, per-repo query strategy, 15-minute interval, merged_at ISO 8601 cursor. Horizon: three independent passes (HORIZON_TRANSACTIONS, HORIZON_TRADES, HORIZON_OPERATIONS) each at 5-minute intervals with paging_token cursor. SSE streaming ruled out. Aquarius API ruled out in favour of Horizon operations pass. Three future sources reserved: GRANTFOX_BOUNTY, TRUSTLESS_WORK, SCF_GRANT — all gated on #009.
